name: Sin, Unending Cataclysm
oracle_text:
Flying, trample
As Sin enters, remove all counters from any number of artifacts, creatures, and enchantments. Sin enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is twice the number of counters removed this way.
When Sin dies, put its counters on target creature you control, then shuffle this card into its owner's library.
blocked_sentences: As Sin enters, remove all counters from any number of artifacts, creatures, and enchantments. Sin enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is twice the number of counters removed this way.

needs.what: An 'As this enters' replacement that runs a choice-plus-effect while the permanent is entering (choose any number of artifacts, creatures and enchantments; remove all counters of every kind from them), binds the total number of counters removed, and then makes the permanent enter with a computed number of +1/+1 counters (twice that total) -- a self_enters_with_counters replacement whose amount is a value bound by an effect run as part of the same replacement
needs.why_existing_wont_do: self_enters_with_counters / enters_with_additional_counters take a fixed or static amount and cannot run effects or choices first; remove_counters_from_among and remove_counters (any_kind) exist only as resolving ops, so writing this as a self_enters trigger would let Sin enter as a 5/5, use the stack (respondable, wrong timing for 'enters with'), and miss interactions keyed on the counters it enters with
